
=================================================================
#75 Kim Chunchu†  (661 June)
Arc: Part III — Kingfall / The Fall of Baekje · place: surabol · tone: psychopomp ritual
Logline: The man who arranged all of it is fifty-eight, and cannot get out of bed.
=================================================================
[0] ¶ Chunchu has talked his way out of every room in Samhan. This one has no other door.
[1] [MAP 661: ]
[2] ── SCENE: The Sickroom ──
[3] ¶ It is the sixth month of 661. Baekje has fallen, Goguryeo has not, and the man who arranged both is fifty-eight and cannot get out of bed.
[4] ¶ Yushin comes in the afternoon, still in his riding boots, and stands where a marshal stands, which is too close to the door.
[5] Kim Yushin: The Tang want us at Pyongyang by winter. / I told them you were busy.
[6] King Muyeol: Busy. Yes. Dying turns out to be a full day’s work. / Brother, sit down for once. You make the room look like a gate.
[7] Kim Yushin: I’ll stand.
[8] King Muyeol: Of course you will. / …Take him north for me. Bupmin. He’ll want to charge the walls. Don’t let him charge the walls.
[9] Kim Yushin: I won’t.
[10] ¶ That is the whole goodbye. They have been saying the rest of it for forty years.
[11] ¶ **Munhee (55)** sits where she has sat since the spring. Outside the door a monk who knows when not to speak keeps the incense going. Forty years ago she bought a dream off her sister for a silk skirt. This is where the dream comes out: a sickroom, a husband, and a son at the foot of the bed.
[12] King Muyeol: Munhee. Have I… paid all of it?
[13] Munhee: Not yet. I’ll pay the rest.
[14] King Muyeol: Do you remember the skirt?
[15] Munhee: It was a very good skirt. / Don’t make me cry in front of the boy.
[16] King Muyeol: Best bargain in Silla.
[17] Munhee: Second best. Bupmin, don’t stand in the door. Come in.
[18] ¶ He looks past her, to the boy who is no longer a boy. **Bupmin (35)** has his mother’s stillness and his father’s hunger, and for a moment the room holds all three of them the way a hill once held a promise.
[19] King Muyeol: Bupmin.
[20] King Munmu: Father.
[21] King Muyeol: People will say… this whole war was only for your sister. / Gotaso. / And they will not be wrong. Daeya never left this room for a single day.
[22] King Muyeol: But that was never the only debt. / On a hill once, with your uncle, I said a thing. “A king for all.” / Not a king of Silla. Of everyone.
[23] King Munmu: And I stole it. I was six. I used to say it at dinner—
[24] King Muyeol: You said it wrong. The word sat crooked in your mouth. / I said it first. You took it. That is how children steal. They take the largest thing in the room. / I cleared the road as far as Baekje. Goguryeo is still standing, and the Tang will be smiling. / The rest — walk it as king. Not as my revenge. As the country you wanted when you were six.
[25] King Munmu: …I promise.
[26] King Muyeol: Bupmin… I love you.
[27] ¶ The escort arrives on schedule.
[28] ¶ Kangrim reads the name three times — Muyeol. Muyeol. Muyeol. The room still knows him as Chunchu.
[29] Kangrim: King Muyeol. / We have met before, at Daeya. You weren’t looking at me. You were looking at a list of names.
[30] King Muyeol: Euija swore heaven would find me. / …Is this heaven?
[31] Kangrim: No. This is a fever. Heaven does not make house calls. I do. / One question, then we walk. Was it for Gotaso, or for the king for all?
[32] King Muyeol: …Yes.
[33] Kangrim: That is not one of the two.
[34] King Muyeol: In go, nobody plays a stone for one reason. / Write it in both columns. Your ledger has two, I assume.
[35] Kangrim: It does. I will. / Come. The road is long, and you will want to talk the whole way.
[36] ¶ King Muyeol (58) dies.
[37] Munhee: …He knelt to everyone. Gesomun. The emperor. Anyone who would hold a door. / Never once to Baekje. / Get up, Bupmin. You’re the king. Kings don’t kneel by beds.
[38] ¶ He died with Baekje gone and Goguryeo still standing. Halfway. The last two names he said were his daughter’s and his son’s. Not the kingdom’s.
[39] ¶ Twelve years earlier an emperor had told him that Goguryeo was the one failure of his life, and that Baekje would be Chunchu’s. Only one of them was wrong.
[40] ¶ They give him a name for the dead: Muyeol. His temple name is Taejong, the same name the Tang gave their Second Emperor. Chang’an will notice.
[41] [CARD King Munmu]
[42] ¶ Bupmin takes the throne. They will call him Munmu.
[43] ¶ **Silla won the war. So why does the emperor’s new edict call its king a clerk…?**
